solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: The deal now being negotiated is shabby

indicators.note: a deal under negotiation is being worked over and reshaped, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone sneers at a poor bargain still being hammered out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'being negotiated' rearranges the ten letters of THE DEAL NOW.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone looking worn out and impoverished, heels trodden down, is described with this idiom for scruffy.

clue.text: Pass away before time — if this is bad?

definitions.text: Pass away before time — if this is bad?

indicators.note: placed ahead of the next piece in the answer, as the clue's order says

parts.note: to pass away is to die

explanation.surface: A warning that a poor eating regime may bring an early death.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue defines too: a bad eating regime might make you die before your time.
explanation.definitionFit: Poor eating habits can shorten a life, so the whole clue describes a food regime gone wrong.

clue.text: A person who does not drink into money and power

indicators.note: the abstainer goes into the word for money, splitting it

parts.note: a wage is money paid for work
TT means teetotal, a teetotaller

explanation.surface: A teetotaller comes into wealth and influence.
explanation.walkthrough: TT, short for teetotal, is the usual crossword abstainer; 'money and power' tempts a two-part definition, but 'and' only links.
explanation.definitionFit: Electrical power measured in watts is the rating of a device.

clue.text: The homeless may be looking for this compromise

definitions.text: The homeless may be looking for this
definitions.meaning: people without a home seek lodging
an agreement where each side gives way

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both lodging and a settlement reached by mutual concession.

clue.text: A right idiot undermining hospital creates worry

indicators.note: in a down answer, sitting underneath means coming after the other piece

parts.note: an ass is a fool

explanation.surface: A complete fool working beneath a hospital causes anxiety.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'undermining' puts A R ASS below H.
explanation.definitionFit: To pester or bother someone persistently is to cause them anxiety, a verb synonym.

clue.text: US marshal needs to get sharper piece of audio equipment

parts.note: Wyatt Earp was a famous lawman of the American West
to hone a blade is to make it sharper

explanation.surface: A Wild West lawman needs a keener edge.
explanation.walkthrough: Wyatt Earp was a deputy US marshal in the Old West, famous for the gunfight at the OK Corral.
explanation.definitionFit: A small speaker worn at the head for listening is a piece of sound kit.

clue.text: One put in grave, as already mentioned

indicators.note: the numeral is placed inside the word for grave

parts.note: grave as an adjective means serious or sad
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: Someone is buried, as was stated earlier.
explanation.walkthrough: 'grave' looks like a noun for burial; here it is the adjective meaning sorrowful.
explanation.definitionFit: Legal phrasing such as 'the said property' uses it for something referred to earlier.

clue.text: For example, a leader?

definitions.meaning: the word 'a' is an example of the indefinite type of this part of speech
a leader is a newspaper's main editorial piece

explanation.definitionFit: The word covers both a part of speech like 'a' or 'the' and a piece of writing in a paper.

clue.text: Party line being held with certain release of information

indicators.note: the line is held inside the word for party

parts.note: a disco is a dance party
sure means certain

explanation.surface: A party policy, held firmly, comes with a guaranteed leak.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Party line' reads as official policy; it splits into DISCO and L.
explanation.definitionFit: Revealing facts that were secret is the act of making them known.

clue.text: Seductive type to come in, wanting one caught, trapped

indicators.note: the two letters are held captive inside the word for coming in

parts.note: to enter is to come in
I is the Roman numeral one
C is the cricket abbreviation for caught

explanation.surface: A seducer comes in, needing a single victim caught and trapped.
explanation.walkthrough: 'wanting' here means needing and only links; 'trapped' is the container signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who lures or tempts another is a seductive sort of person.

clue.text: Goes round a hill to the west with group returning

indicators.note: in an across answer, heading west means reading right to left

parts.note: a tor is a rocky hill, as on Dartmoor

indicators.note: coming back means reading the word backwards

parts.note: a set is a group

explanation.surface: Someone walks round a hill westward with a party heading back.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to the west' turns A TOR into ROTA; 'returning' turns SET into TES.
explanation.definitionFit: Spinning on an axis or taking turns is what this verb means, matching circling.

clue.text: What may offer 3 in a row

definitions.text: What may offer 3 in a row

parts.words: What may offer 3 in a row
parts.note: 3 is the answer to 3-down, lodging; these homes stand joined in a line

explanation.definitionFit: A home joined on both sides to others in a continuous street line provides lodging in a row.

clue.text: Pastor Michael could be up in the clouds maybe?

indicators.note: says the letters of the name could be something else once rearranged

explanation.surface: A clergyman named Michael might be dreamy and detached.
explanation.walkthrough: 'could be' rearranges the thirteen letters of PASTOR MICHAEL.
explanation.definitionFit: Clouds are in the air surrounding the earth, so anything up there relates to that envelope of air.

clue.text: Extra bits of written material I'd pen with space free

indicators.note: set free, the letters are loosened into a new order

explanation.surface: A writer pens additions where there is room to spare.
explanation.walkthrough: 'free' rearranges the letters of I'D PEN and SPACE; 'with' only links.
explanation.definitionFit: Supplementary sections at the back of a book are added material.

clue.text: Chemical in Italian river and lake occupied by bird

indicators.note: the river's letters have the bird living inside them

parts.note: the Po is the longest river in Italy
a hen is a bird

explanation.surface: A substance found in an Italian river and a lake where a bird lives.
explanation.walkthrough: The Po flows across northern Italy into the Adriatic.
explanation.definitionFit: Carbolic acid, an aromatic compound used as a disinfectant, is a chemical.

clue.text: Unwelcome visitors disturbed maidservant putting out mat

indicators.note: upset or agitated, the letters are thrown into a new order
the letters of the other word are removed from the pool

explanation.surface: A rattled maid puts the doormat outside, expecting unwanted guests.
explanation.walkthrough: Take M, A, T out of MAIDSERVANT, leaving IDSERVAN, and 'disturbed' rearranges those.
explanation.definitionFit: Hostile forces or pests that enter uninvited are unwanted arrivals.

clue.text: Be left standing in capital city

parts.note: a grade is a rank or standing

explanation.surface: Someone is stranded in a capital.
explanation.walkthrough: 'left standing' reads as stranded; it is two pieces, L and GRADE.
explanation.definitionFit: The Serbian seat of government is a European capital.

clue.text: Moves to another country abandoning good Arab lands

indicators.note: the letter for good is left out of the longer word

parts.note: someone who emigrates leaves to settle abroad

explanation.surface: Emigrants leave behind good Arab countries.
explanation.walkthrough: 'abandoning' drops G from EMIGRATES.
explanation.definitionFit: Gulf states ruled by princes, as in the federation on the Persian Gulf, are Arab territories.

clue.text: Pub drink, did you say? I know things others don't

indicators.note: asks how the words sound when spoken

parts.note: an inn is a pub; cider is a drink made from apples

explanation.surface: Someone at the bar asks about a drink, then boasts of secret knowledge.
explanation.walkthrough: INN CIDER said out loud gives the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone within an organisation has knowledge outsiders lack, so the phrase describes one in first person.

clue.text: Nasty cricket delivery to get one smiling?

definitions.meaning: a full toss bowled at head height without bouncing
someone who beams is grinning broadly

explanation.walkthrough: In cricket this is a dangerous ball that reaches the batter at head height without bouncing.
explanation.definitionFit: It is both a dangerous head-high full toss in cricket and a person who grins.

clue.text: Chum protecting journalist, one to act as a go-between

indicators.note: the friend's letters surround and shield the others

parts.note: a mate is a friend
ED is short for editor, a journalist
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A friend shields a reporter, someone who negotiates between parties.
explanation.walkthrough: 'protecting' puts EDI inside MATE, after its M.
explanation.definitionFit: To intervene between disputing parties to bring agreement is to broker a deal between them.

clue.text: Strip bar on Little Street

parts.note: a dive is a seedy bar
ST is the short form of street

explanation.surface: A strip club on a minor road.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Little' signals shortening Street to ST.
explanation.definitionFit: To deprive or rid someone of something, such as clothing or assets, is to strip them.

clue.text: Determined to be famous

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both told apart from others and eminent or renowned.

clue.text: Food kept in home — atrocious!

indicators.note: the letters are held within the run of words

explanation.surface: Someone complains that the food stored at home is dreadful.
explanation.definitionFit: Animal flesh eaten as food, or food generally in older use.

clue.text: Extra notes about South Africa strewn across a study

indicators.note: the outer pieces are spread around the inner ones

parts.note: C stands for circa, about
ZA is the international code for South Africa
a den is a study

explanation.surface: Additional musical notes about South Africa are scattered across a study.
explanation.walkthrough: 'strewn across' puts C and ZA either side of A DEN.
explanation.definitionFit: A soloist's ornamental flourish near a concerto's end is a passage added to the score.

clue.text: Imitate bird having got out of office

parts.note: the emu is a large flightless Australian bird
late can mean former, as in the late chairman

explanation.surface: A bird has left its job and now copies others.
explanation.definitionFit: To copy someone in the hope of matching them is to mimic them.

clue.text: Kind of game not to be played gently

indicators.note: the musical letter is left out of the word

parts.note: a sport is a game
P is piano, the musical direction to play softly

explanation.surface: A sport that should never be played softly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not to be played' drops P from SPORT.
explanation.definitionFit: A type or category of thing, as in 'that sort of person'.

clue.text: Getting rid of debt in colony

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both the paying of an account and a place where people have made a new home.
